integrity: The homotopy assertion is supported by a fully specified finite acyclic matching verified exhaustively by the included standalone Python 3 checker; no independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite classification for P4 Cartesian P4 only, not a general theorem for larger square-sequence graphs. Numerical Betti ranks are previously published (Bayer et al., Table 3). Unpublished matching certificates could affect priority.
title: Integral homotopy classification of robust clique complexes on the \(4\times4\) grid
